irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: Contribución sobre la Renta, Ley 6-2-1943

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IGRPF after Decretos-ley 12/1973 and 13/1975
irpf_top_marginal_rate.source: Alvaredo & Saez (2010), 'Income and Wealth Concentration in Spain in a Historical and Fiscal Perspective', ch.10 in Atkinson & Piketty (eds.), Top Incomes: A Global Perspective, OUP (shorter version: JEEA 7(5), 2009)

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IRPF, Ley 44/1978 (BOE-A-1978-23326)
irpf_top_marginal_rate.source: Ley 44/1978, de 8 de septiembre, del IRPF
irpf_top_marginal_rate.note: Cuota capped at 40% of the tax base (55% jointly with wealth tax). No scale change found for 1980 in BOE amendment list, so 1979-1980.

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IRPF scale for 1981, Ley 74/1980 PGE 1981
irpf_top_marginal_rate.note: Matches A&S Table 10C.2 col. 9 (1981).

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IRPF scale for 1982, Ley 44/1981 PGE 1982
irpf_top_marginal_rate.locator: art. 29.Uno (top 68,47); art. 29.Dos (average-rate cap raised from 40% to 42%)
irpf_top_marginal_rate.note: Matches A&S Table 10C.2 col. 9 (1982).

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IRPF scale 1984-1987, Ley 44/1983 PGE 1984
irpf_top_marginal_rate.locator: art. 27 (top 66,00; cap 46% of base, 70% with wealth tax)
irpf_top_marginal_rate.note: Same 66% top confirmed for 1987 in Ley 33/1987 art. 88.Uno; A&S Table 10C.2 col. 9 gives 66 for 1984-1987.

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IRPF scale for 1988, Ley 33/1987 PGE 1988
irpf_top_marginal_rate.note: 46% average-rate cap eliminated (only the 70% joint cap with wealth tax remains). A&S Table 10C.2 col. 9: 56 for 1988-1998.

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IRPF Ley 18/1991, scale raised by RDL 5/1992
irpf_top_marginal_rate.note: Ley 18/1991 (BOE-A-1991-14391, art. 74) originally set 53%; RDL 5/1992 raised it to 56% for periods ending in 1992. 56% reconfirmed in Ley 41/1994 (BOE-A-1994-28967).

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IRPF Ley 40/1998: state 39.6 + autonómica/complementaria 8.4
irpf_top_marginal_rate.source: Ley 40/1998, de 9 de diciembre, del IRPF
irpf_top_marginal_rate.locator: art. 50 (state scale top 39,60) + art. 61 (escala autonómica o complementaria top 8,40)
irpf_top_marginal_rate.note: Combined state + complementary scale (regions could alter their part only within limits). Matches A&S Table 10C.2 col. 9 (48 for 1999-2002).

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IRPF Ley 46/2002: state 29.16 + complementaria 15.84
irpf_top_marginal_rate.locator: art. 26 (new art. 50 Ley 40/1998, top 29,16) + new art. 61 (top 15,84)
irpf_top_marginal_rate.note: Matches A&S Table 10C.2 col. 9 (45 for 2003-2005).

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IRPF Ley 35/2006: state 27.13 + complementaria 15.87
irpf_top_marginal_rate.source: Ley 35/2006, de 28 de noviembre, del IRPF
irpf_top_marginal_rate.locator: art. 63 (top 27,13) + art. 74 (escala autonómica o complementaria, top 15,87)
irpf_top_marginal_rate.note: Same 27.13 + 15.87 kept for 2010 by Ley 26/2009 art. 68 (BOE-A-2009-20765); Ley 22/2009 DT 15ª default regional scale for 2010 also tops at 21.5 on a 21.5 state scale = 43.

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IRPF: state 23.5 (Ley 39/2010) + regional reference 21.5
irpf_top_marginal_rate.locator: art. 62.Uno (art. 63 LIRPF: 22,5 above 120,000.20 EUR, 23,5 above 175,000.20 EUR)
irpf_top_marginal_rate.note: From 2011 each region legislates its own scale (art. 74 LIRPF as amended; no legal default). Combined value uses the 21.5% top of the Ley 22/2009 (BOE-A-2009-20375) reference regional scale; actual combined top varied by region (e.g. higher in Cataluña/Andalucía). State component is high confidence.

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IRPF + gravamen complementario 2012-2014 (+7 points above 300,000 EUR)
irpf_top_marginal_rate.locator: disposición final segunda, apartado Primero (adds DA 35ª LIRPF: complementary scale, top +7 above 300,000.20 EUR; also +7 on the withholding scale)
irpf_top_marginal_rate.note: State 23.5 + 7 = 30.5, plus regional reference 21.5 = 52. Extended to 2014 by later law (not re-checked). Same regional-reference caveat as 2011.

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IRPF Ley 26/2014: state 23.5 (2015 transitional scale); combined withholding scale top 47
irpf_top_marginal_rate.locator: DA 31ª LIRPF (2015 scales: state top 23,50; withholding scale top 47,00)
irpf_top_marginal_rate.note: Convention for 2015+: combined top = top of the legal withholding scale (state + reference regional half). Many secondary sources quote 46% for 2015 (23.5 + 22.5 typical regional). Regional tops varied.

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IRPF Ley 26/2014: state 22.5 (>60,000 EUR) + reference regional 22.5
irpf_top_marginal_rate.locator: art. 1 (art. 63.1 LIRPF top 22,50; art. 101 withholding scale top 45,00)
irpf_top_marginal_rate.note: State component high confidence; combined uses withholding-scale convention.

irpf_top_marginal_rate.label: IRPF: new state bracket 24.5 above 300,000 EUR + reference regional 22.5
irpf_top_marginal_rate.locator: art. 58 (art. 63.1 LIRPF top 24,50 above 300,000 EUR); withholding scale top 47,00
irpf_top_marginal_rate.note: Still in force 2026 (consolidated art. 63 checked). Actual 2025 combined range across common-regime regions: 45% (Madrid, regional top 20.5) to 54% (C. Valenciana, regional top 29.5); Hacienda, Tributación Autonómica. Medidas 2025, cap. I, pp.4-5: https://www.hacienda.gob.es/sgfal/financiacionterritorial/autonomica/capitulo-i-tributacion-autonomica-2025.pdf . País Vasco/Navarra (foral) excluded throughout.

vat_standard_rate.label: ITE (Impuesto General sobre el Tráfico de las Empresas), tipo general
vat_standard_rate.source: Decreto 3314/1966, de 29 de diciembre, texto refundido ITE (tax created by Ley 41/1964, de 11 de junio)
vat_standard_rate.note: Cascade turnover tax, not comparable with VAT. 1.5% verified in the 1966 TR and again as 'tipo general del uno coma cinco por ciento' in Ley 6/1979 (BOE-A-1979-23318); the 1964 original law text was not checked. A provincial surcharge (0.5% per Ley 6/1979) is excluded.

vat_standard_rate.label: ITE tipo general raised to 3%
vat_standard_rate.locator: art. 19.1 (new art. 13 TR ITE: tipo general 3); in force 30-6-1983
vat_standard_rate.note: Other ITE rates set at the same time (e.g. 4% manufacturer-to-retail sales); provincial surcharge of 1% on the general rate (same law) excluded. No intermediate change 1967-1983 found, but BOE amendment list is incomplete.
